issue.body:
## Problem

Nothing runs the sample-kit tests on pull requests.

## Fix

Add a workflow that runs `npm ci` and `npm test` in `plugins/sample-kit` on every pull request.

## Done when

- [ ] The tests run on each pull request and its result shows on the PR.

pr.title: ci(sample-kit): run the sample-kit tests on pull requests
pr.body: Adds a workflow that runs the sample-kit tests on every pull request, including ones from forks.
